entities.name: Hofri Ghostforge
entities.description: Dwarf cleric professor at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven who can build statues for spirits to inhabit.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University on Arcavios that Hofri attended and teaches at.

entities.name: Lorehold College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven whose battle mediums turn spirits into soldiers.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: Strixhaven college Hofri first believed his future lay with.

entities.name: Mavinda
entities.description: Counselor of Strixhaven who advised Hofri.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Young loxodon assistant at the archaeological excavations.

events.summary: Hofri enrolled at Strixhaven believing he belonged in Prismari but his magic lacked flair.
events.quote: When Hofri first enrolled in Strixhaven , he believed his future lay with Prismari .

events.summary: After talking with counselor Mavinda, Hofri switched to Lorehold and proved a natural at spirit magic.
events.quote: Hofri decided to try his luck with Lorehold .

events.summary: Hofri became the first to build spirit statues from scratch and was offered a professorship.
events.quote: Hofri was offered a professorial position after graduation, which he happily accepted.

events.summary: Hofri led archaeological excavations near Strixhaven with Quintorius Kand as assistant.
events.quote: Hofri was the leader of the archaeological excavations near Strixhaven

relations.quote: Hofri Ghostforge is a dwarf cleric professor at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .
where Quintorius Kand was an assistant
